subject.title: Follow-up: optimize fallback order + add model-input config guardrail

question: Should OpenClaw keep operator-ordered fallback lists as the source of truth, or add a benchmark-backed latency/quality/cost policy layer plus semantic `models.providers.*.models[].input` capability validation?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally preserve configured fallback order and multimodal model metadata, so changing either behavior needs maintainer product and compatibility intent.

options.title: Design policy first
options.body: Keep this open while maintainers define fallback-ranking criteria and a safe capability authority for configured custom providers.

options.title: Split and narrow
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287 own the guardrail subset and open or select a separate fallback-policy tracker for benchmark ranking.

options.title: Defer ranking
options.body: Document that operators own fallback ordering and only pursue capability diagnostics that do not reject existing config by default.

recommendation.title: Design policy first
recommendation.body: Keep this open while maintainers define fallback-ranking criteria and a safe capability authority for configured custom providers.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal across provider catalog, media defaults, docs, and the issue timeline for the product/compatibility decision.
